summary: Iteration 30: full re-test, using the real-AI account t_ai_12258 plus fresh @example.com accounts. Zero AI calls (no /analyze, /chat or /deep). Zero real emails sent. No Stripe payment: only a checkout session was created. RESULT PER AREA: (1) Real data on /area: PASS. KPIs match /overview (2 docs, 2 no_issues, 0 high, 0 overdue). Documenti shows both docs as 'Cliente: Rossi SRL (automatico)' / 'Verdi Spa (automatico)'. Each Client 360 shows its document; the Scadenze tab shows the detected deadlines. There were no priorities at start because all deadlines were >30 days away, so I created a temporary manual deadline (TEST_UI_PRIO, deleted afterwards). Priority click opens doc-panel with fields, checks, deadlines and the client link. (2) Deadlines: PASS. Confirm with chips 15+7 works, showing 'Confermata · avvisi: 15 gg prima, 7 gg prima'. The Italian calendar works (Settembre 2027, Lun..Dom, next month = Ottobre); picking the 15th saves 15/10/2027 and the item stays 'Rilevata'. 'Avvisa anche il cliente' shows the textarea with a 20/500 counter and the message persists. DA VERIFICARE (seeded directly in DB on a fresh account, no AI): confirm without a date gives 400; set date then confirm gives confirmed with notify_days [3]; delete works, a second delete gives 404. Unconfirmed auto deadlines are absent from GET /api/reminders, confirmed ones are present. (3) Multi-doc audit: PASS. Shows 4 sections (Coerenze, Differenze, Possibili anomalie, Da verificare) with Documento A/B chips; deep was NOT run. All 4 sections are empty for invoice vs contract, which is correct per core.compare (different categories, no shared subjects). (4) Client 360: PASS. PDF download report-rossi-srl.pdf; content contains the client name and no 'rischio'/'red flag'. Email field saved; send gives 'Indirizzo non consentito per l'invio.' and a row 'Non inviata (indirizzo di prova) / Report PDF' in Email inviate. Per-client .ics download works. Feed create/regenerate/revoke works: old token 404, new 200, after revoke 404. (5) Global calendar .ics (2 confirmed events, detected one excluded) and feed create/revoke: PASS. Digest toggle on/off works; preview gives 'Invio non riuscito per questo indirizzo.' with an email_log digest_preview skipped_reserved_domain entry. Studio form save works and persists; logo upload (shown via auth blob) and remove work. (6) Isolation: PASS. A fresh account gets 404 on client 360, report.pdf, emails, client ics/feed, patch client, document, deadline patch/delete/confirm, report send and audit with foreign ids; its lists are empty in both API and UI. (7) Core regressions: PASS. Register via AuthModal gives 3 credits, login, logout clears da_token and /area becomes locked. History modal shows 2 items for the real account and empty for a fresh one. Credits badge correct. Referral endpoint OK. /api/packages prices are 19/49/149/29/99/299. Stripe checkout returns checkout_url plus a cs_live_ session_id. Legacy reminders CRUD OK. (8) Regression suites: 63 passed, 3 skipped, 2 errors on the first run. Both errors were in test_email_digest_client_mail.py and caused by the register rate limit (5/hour/IP, in-memory) being exhausted by earlier suites in the same run. On rerun that file passed 8/8. New tests/test_iter30_retest.py: 16/16 passed. (9) Responsive 1920 and 390: PASS. No page-level horizontal overflow (scrollWidth == clientWidth on all /area tabs and Client 360 tabs); the nav and tab bars scroll inside their own containers; the calendar popover fits at 390. No blocking console errors; the only errors were the expected 400s from blocked sends.

minor.issue: The in-memory limit of 5 registrations/hour/IP is hit when the regression suites run back-to-back (each module registers 1-2 users), so fixtures fail with KeyError 'user' (429). Not an app bug, but it makes the suite flaky unless the backend restarts in between. Consider a test bypass or reusing users across modules.

ui_bugs.issue: Typed text can vanish about 1 s after opening the Clienti tab. Reproduced on attempt 2 of 2 (Indirizzo typed, then empty after 2 s). RCA: the effect runs ws.get('/studio').then(setF) without a cancel/dirty guard. In dev, React.StrictMode (index.js) runs the effect twice, so the second GET response overwrites what the user typed. Preview only; the production build is not affected. Fix: ignore the response if unmounted/cancelled or if the form is dirty.

POST /audits is fired from useEffect, so StrictMode in preview creates 2 identical audit records per 'Confronta' click (2 records with the same created_at seen in the DB). Production is not affected. Deep runs on a button click, so no double credit charge. Fix: create the audit in the click handler (Documents compare-btn) or add a ref guard.

issues: Comparing documents of different categories (invoice vs contract) shows 4 empty sections with no explanation; a hint such as 'documenti di tipo diverso: confronto limitato ai soggetti' would avoid confusion
The default tab is 'Prossimi 7 giorni (0)' even when all deadlines are under 'Oltre 30 giorni', so the user first sees 'Nessuna scadenza.' Consider defaulting to the first non-empty bucket

action_items: Optional: add a cancel/dirty guard to StudioSettings load effect (StrictMode double GET overwrites typed input in preview)
Optional: move POST /audits out of useEffect (or add a ref guard) to avoid duplicate audit records in preview
Optional: make the regression suites robust to the register rate limit (5/h/IP)
Optional UX: explain empty audit for different document types; default the Scadenze tab to the first non-empty bucket
critical_code_review_comments: Logo content type is now derived from magic bytes (iteration 29 minor issue resolved)
Effects that write data (POST /audits) and effects that set form state without a cancel guard (StudioSettings) behave differently under StrictMode: preview-only symptoms, but fragile
router.py (823 lines) and server.py (>1500 lines) still exceed the 700-line guideline

success_rate.backend: 100% (2 regression errors were test-env rate-limit, passed on rerun)
